# Exercise-05

## Applied Data Analysis excercise

```{r}
#Step 1
##Lets start loading the dictionaries

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

## Load the data file

f<- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/difiore/ada-datasets/refs/heads/main/IMDB-movies.csv"

d<- read_csv(f, col_names = TRUE)
view(d)
print(d)
colnames(d)

#Step 2
##filter the dataset

s<- filter (d, startYear >= "1920" & startYear <= "1979", runtimeMinutes >= "60" & runtimeMinutes<= "180")
  
summarise(s)  
  

```
